mapper.sql: sc.id, sc.student_id, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, ci.class_name, sc.course_id, c.course_name, sc.usual_score, sc.exam_score, sc.total_score, sc.semester

where.if: AND (s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN class_info ci ON s.class_id = ci.id JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id
ORDER BY s.student_no ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(sc.total_score), 1) AS avgScore, MAX(sc.total_score) AS maxScore, MIN(sc.total_score) AS minScore, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, COUNT(sc.id) AS totalCount FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id

SELECT FROM score sc JOIN student s ON sc.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN class_info ci ON s.class_id = ci.id JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.semester = #{semester} ORDER BY sc.semester DESC, c.id ASC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_score), 1) FROM score WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND total_score IS NOT NULL AND semester = #{semester}

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sc.total_score * c.credit) / NULLIF(SUM(c.credit), 0), 1) FROM score sc JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.total_score IS NOT NULL AND sc.semester = #{semester}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (student_id, course_id, usual_score, exam_score, total_score, semester) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{usualScore}, #{examScore}, #{totalScore}, #{semester}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE usual_score = VALUES(usual_score), exam_score = VALUES(exam_score), total_score = VALUES(total_score)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) FROM score
